subject: Request: adjusted offer for Senior ML Lead - approval needed
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: adjusted offer for Senior ML Lead (Evelyn Zhao) - sign-on / equity refresh

Hi Vivek —

Following our phone wrap yesterday, I'm sending the proposed offer adjustments for Evelyn Zhao (Senior ML Lead). Candidate is excited and has two competing offers; she asked for a stronger initial package than our band. Summary attached.

What we're asking:
- One-time sign-on payment: $25,000 (gross, paid in first payroll)
- Equity refresh bump at hire: additional 0.25% one-time grant from refresh pool (vests 1yr cliff then monthly)
- Base salary at top of band (no base increase beyond band)

Rationale: Evelyn is a strategic hire for product-recommendation infra; she brings deep latency/ops expertise and a small team. Comp table attached shows that typical market comp for comparable roles is ~10-15% above our midpoint given Seattle market. We expect ramp to materially accelerate our recommender roadmap.

Attachments: offer_summary_EZ_1126.pdf, comp_band_matrix_Q4_2026.xlsx, candidate_resume_EZ.pdf

Asking for approval from leadership + finance by EOD Friday (2026-12-04) to keep momentum. If you prefer an alternate mix (higher sign-on vs any equity), say the word and I'll coordinate with legal/comp to draft.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: adjusted offer for Senior ML Lead (Evelyn Zhao) - sign-on / equity refresh

Thanks Monica — quick clarifying questions before I commit:

1) Headcount: Is this hire within my approved headcount for Q4? (I believe yes but want confirmation of the WL/req ID).
2) Budget source: Are we funding the $25k sign-on from hiring manager discretionary or from the central comp flexibility pool?
3) Equity mechanics: Is the 0.25% coming from a special ad-hoc grant or from the standard refresh pool? Any precedent recently for hires at this level?
4) Retention clause: can we attach the normal clawback for sign-on if the hire leaves within 12 months?

If finance prefers, I would rather see a smaller cash sign-on ($15k) + ability to revisit a half-year refresh if milestones are hit. Please include expected start date and notice period details for her current employer.

cc: Laura / Hannah — putting you on for approvals and comp guidance.

- Vivek
VP, Machine Learning Infrastructure

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: adjusted offer for Senior ML Lead (Evelyn Zhao) - sign-on / equity refresh

Vivek / Monica —

I reviewed the materials and I'll approve the requested mix on principle given the strategic nature of the role and the competing offer timeline. My ask/conditions:

- Approve one-time sign-on of $20,000 (reduced from $25k) paid in first payroll.
- Approve 0.20% one-time equity grant from the refresh pool (not from market buyout reserve). Vesting: 25% at 1yr then monthly over the remaining 3 years (aligns with standard policy).
- Add a 12-month clawback for sign-on (full repayment if voluntary departure within 12 months).
- Manager to commit to a 6-month performance checkpoint; if milestone X is reached, we can consider an additional 0.05% refresh at the 6mo mark (finance sign-off required).

Hannah — please confirm budget & payroll implications (particularly the payroll run needed to get the sign-on paid in first check) and update comp tracking in the Q4 band sheet.

Monica — if that works, ask Legal to prepare the redlined offer letter and I'll provide the signature authority for this headcount. We should capture the approval in the candidate's Greenhouse record for the audit trail.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Talent & People Ops

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Nicole Tran <nicole.tran@talentworks.co>, Evelyn Zhao <evelyn.zhao@example.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: adjusted offer for Senior ML Lead (Evelyn Zhao) - sign-on / equity refresh

Thanks all — we are aligned. Next steps:

- Monica -> Legal: create redlined offer reflecting $20,000 sign-on, 0.20% one-time equity grant, standard 12mo clawback. (Attachment: redlined_offer_EZ.docx)
- Hannah -> Finance: confirm payroll run and misc accounting entries (HR-4521 open). Please reply-all once payroll cut-off is confirmed.
- Vivek -> Confirm the 6-month milestone language you'd like in the note (I can draft).

Nicole / Ian (external recruiters) — I'll send the updated offer to Evelyn after Legal signs off. Target send to candidate: 12/02/2026 morning PST. Evelyn's anticipated start date (tentative): 01/18/2027; notice at current employer is 4 weeks.

Linking records: Greenhouse ID https://greenhouse.io/app/candidates/REDW-99827, Workday ticket HR-4521, DocuSign link will be created after Legal uploads.
